title: What Medical Assistants Do
description: Medical assistants are healthcare's versatile generalists: rooming patients, taking vitals, drawing blood, performing EKGs, giving injections, assisting with exams and minor procedures, plus scheduling, billing, and records. They work in clinics and physician offices — the engine room of outpatient care.
requirements: High school diploma; accredited MA program (certificate to associate degree)
standards: Scope: clinical and administrative under provider direction
safety: Verify patient identity before procedures
Medication administration only within scope and training
Sharps safety and disposal

troubleshooting: Difficult venipuncture: warm, re-anchor, or get help
Anxious patient: explain, distract, go slowly
EKG artifact: check lead placement and skin prep
Schedule chaos: triage by urgency, communicate waits
